title: glycosmis arborea
intro: Glycosmis arborea, commonly known as Semar, is a plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family, native to Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Glycosmis arborea include its ability to aid in digestion, alleviate symptoms of fever, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of Glycosmis arborea include limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
